svg.title: Linux Server Troubleshooting Flowchart
svg.desc: A decision tree for diagnosing common Linux server problems, starting with initial checks and branching into service, network, disk, performance, and security categories.
svg.text: Crashed service · Port conflict · Full disk · Bad config · Cert expired
Read logs · Confirm the cause · Test the fix · Verify it worked
Start at the top — initial checks first, then follow the symptom category down
Commands shown are starting points — always read output carefully before acting
